Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 20
, Reason for Mistake: They assumed that the presence of “[other]” on the arXiv listing implied a .ps (PostScript) file was available for every article and equated the total number of entries (97) to the count with .ps. The listing page does not indicate .ps availability; one must check each article’s “other formats” page or use the API. This unjustified assumption led directly to the incorrect final answer.
